limitations: HLTV is identity/form evidence only: its match pages carry a Betting table, but for every fixture in this sweep that table held only a Stake sweepstakes promotion and no bookmaker odds; community 'Pick a winner' percentages are fan votes and are never a win probability.

EGamersWorld numbers are its published aggregated bookmaker odds (the page labels the sponsor feed); they are third-party aggregation, copied verbatim here (e.g. Acend 2.37 / UNiTY 1.5 observed 2026-10-23T10:25Z). A value of exactly 1.8/1.8 also appears on unpriced fixtures, so 1.8/1.8 is treated as a placeholder, not an engaged book.

EGW, HLTV and Hotspawn display match times in different zones and occasionally disagree by an hour; the reviewed ladder only joins sources inside a 60-second start window, which is why some of these verbatim lines remain leads rather than consumed prices.

No value in this record is a probability computed by this session, and no pick is changed by it. Where an independent read disagrees with the published research-model direction, the row is flagged for human review instead of silently edited.
